messages:
marta: dropped a compact 'change annotations' mock into figma → https://figma.com/file/abc123 (see frame: Deploy > Timeline Compact). Goal: reduce vertical noise on repo pages while keeping canary/A+B and rollback affordances discoverable. :eyes:
kevin: looks nice. quick nit: the canary percent slider needs explicit tick labels for screenreader users and keyboard increments. currently it's visually just a handle. suggested: accessible label + aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow.
olivia: agree on the slider. also microcopy thought: the rollback CTA reads "Rollback" which feels scary. can we try: "Revert to previous version" and in the modal include a one-line consequence summary? e.g.
```
Heading: Revert to version v1.4.2
Body: This will stop new traffic to the current version and route it to v1.4.2. In-flight requests may be interrupted. You can undo within 5 minutes.
Buttons: Cancel / Revert to v1.4.2
```
sam: +1 on safer language. accessibility: color alone is used to indicate canary vs stable (green/blue). for color-blind folks we should add a patterned border or small glyph and also use text abbreviations in the timeline (C for canary, S for stable) that are screen-reader exposed.
marta: good call — i'd rather C/S than relying on hover. also thinking about a subtle delta chevron to indicate there were config changes between versions; clicking expands inline diff. keeps timeline compact but surfaces breaky changes.
kevin: inline diff should default to collapsed. when expanded, ensure focus trap doesn't steal keyboard nav from timeline. ARIA: use aria-expanded on the row and move focus to the diff region with aria-labelledby. keyboard: esc to close.
olivia: copy for the diff CTA: "Show changes (config + env)" — short and explicit. Also request: the timeline scrubber needs a clear current selection announcement for screenreaders: "Version v1.4.2 selected, deployed 2 days ago, canary 10%".
sam: contrast check: the tiny percentage pill (10%) on top of the heatmap fails AA on dark mode. increase contrast or add a semi-opaque backing. alternative: show percentage as plain text next to the pill on narrow widths.
design-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: keyboard nav, ARIA live region for timeline updates, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for critical badges, descriptive alt text for any icons.
marta: action items: 1) update slider with ticks + aria attrs (kevin) 2) update rollback modal copy (olivia) 3) add glyph + text labels for canary/stable + pattern indicator (sam) 4) prototype inline diff collapsed state + focus handling (marta). i'll iterate frames and post v2 by EOD.
kevin: small copy tweak for the rollback modal body: replace 'interrupt' with 'may interrupt' — less definitive.
olivia: ok to add a tiny 'undo window' microcopy under the revert CTA? e.g., "Undo available for 5 minutes" in muted text.
marta: will add. thanks y'all — will ping when v2 is ready. :raised_hands:
